facts.text: Broadway East is a developing East Baltimore neighborhood that is experiencing a resurgence after a long period of disinvestment.
The American Brewery building on Gay Street was renovated and reopened as the headquarters of nonprofit Humanim, Inc., and the Baltimore Food Hub, a 3.5‑acre campus of food‑related businesses.
Collington Square Park, the neighborhood’s focal point, is often called the Federal Hill of the East for its historic charm and community events.
A Community Preservation Plan for Broadway East was outlined at a meeting held at the Living Classrooms facility, highlighting the area’s history and future strategies.
Long‑time residents of Broadway East welcome newcomers, keeping the neighborhood’s rich history alive while forging a transformative future.
Broadway East’s name reflects its location on the eastern side of Baltimore’s historic Broadway corridor.
